items.html: Know that the infant, even during the time of his Ibur and during the time of his Yenika, has Mochin, as above; and they are clothed within the NHY of Ima, only they are in the aspect of their externality. And however, at the time of the Ibur all the Mochin depart from him — especially the Hassadim and Gevurot of the Daat — and there illuminate in him only the garments of Ima alone, in the secret of their externality, as mentioned.
